messages.subject: For Ross Bhappu | Uranium, rare earths and strategic-minerals execution
messages.body:
Dear Ms. Casey,

Please place this executive introduction before Mr. Ross Bhappu, President and Chief Executive Officer.

Energy Fuels' growth across uranium, rare earths and strategic minerals places government engagement, regulatory execution, resource security and stakeholder confidence close to long-term value creation. Those priorities align strongly with the work I lead today inside a major multinational mining operation.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My mandate combines government and regulatory relations, ESG, social performance, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory. I manage senior institutional engagement, coordinate complex regulatory and stakeholder matters across operating functions, and translate external commitments into accountable owners, evidence, timelines and escalation. I also support stakeholder governance around approximately 46 to 50 MWp of solar capacity and more than 80 MWh of battery storage and coordinated a carbon-accounting evidence pilot using operating data.

I would welcome a senior conversation about where this experience might support Energy Fuels' government-relations, strategic-minerals, stakeholder or international growth priorities. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to Energy Fuels.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
